Three-item builds tested in complete 6v6 battles. Click a Pokémon to compare the finalists, native suggestions and matchup results.

Builds were frozen before final confirmation and were not reselected afterward. Battle score counts a win as 1 and a draw as 0.5. 101 of 171 picks are close to the runner-up. Confirmation favors the runner-up for 20 picks. Rankings depend on the tested teams, placements and captured game version.
PokémonStarsSelected itemsConfirmation scorevs nativeEvidence
All 1771 combinations include legal repeated items. Screening uses 8 battles per build; only finalists receive the larger held-out test. No weather, boons or component availability constraints. Three synthetic Eevee branch states at star 1 are excluded. Native traits, item effects, targeting and seeded randomness are retained.
Measured search: 49.69 minutes using 5 workers on AMD Ryzen 5 7500F 6-Core Processor . Throughput is battles per second, not full games per second. Raw results   Fixtures and settings
